title: Design System: Jason Joel Pinto Portfolio

display.purpose: Hero name and project detail page H1. Appears at most once per page.

headline.purpose: Section titles via SectionHead. One per section.

title.purpose: Project titles, Experience job titles, card titles. Often paired with a cobalt @ Company suffix.

body.purpose: Section ledes, About paragraphs, project summaries. Capped at 62–75ch.

label.purpose: Every meta marker: section numbers, project years, metric labels, contact-row keys. JetBrains Mono uppercase 0.2em tracking.

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: Default Card shadow at rest. Just enough to seat the card on its background.

shadows.name: card-lift-hover
shadows.value: 0 10px 28px -14px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.72 0.165 256) 22%, transparent), 0 2px 6px -2px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.965 0.006 256) 8%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Hover state on .card-lift. Diffuse cobalt-tinted glow that carries brand information in the shadow itself.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Composite focus ring (outer cobalt ring + 2px background offset). Applied via :focus-visible.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Default easing for color, opacity, and short transform transitions (180–320ms).

motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: Tab content cross-fade, ProjectIndex row reveals, list-row hover shift.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Hero reveals, ProjectIndex row arrow translation, command palette entrance.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Hover color shifts on links and ghost buttons.

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Card-lift, tab cross-fade, ProjectIndex row shift.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: ProjectIndex row dimming on sibling hover, signature transitions where slower reads as more deliberate.

narrative.overview: A hiring-funnel portfolio designed to read as a working analyst's surface, not a marketing page. Magazine-grade typography meets terminal-native craft: oversized display headings sit next to JetBrains Mono microlabels, a real cmd+K palette opens with ⌘K, a hero terminal block prints actual text. Every piece of visible craft is functional. The system commits to a dark-by-default surface tinted toward a single hue (cobalt blue, hue 256 in OKLCH). Editorial Cobalt is the only accent in the entire system, used sparingly: brand mark, primary CTAs, hover states, metric values, and focus rings. When cobalt appears, it means pay attention here. Restraint is the brand.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-by-default; light theme as a first-class secondary, not an afterthought.
One accent (Editorial Cobalt) at restrained dose. Everything else is tinted neutral.
OKLCH tokens throughout; no #fff, no #000, no untinted grays.
Mono microlabels (JetBrains Mono, 11px, 0.2em tracking, uppercase) as the connective tissue between sections, lists, and meta.
Flat at rest, reactive on state. Cards lift on hover with a tinted cobalt shadow; the header re-mixes its blur and tint as the page scrolls.
Motion is cursor-driven, hover-driven, or scroll-driven. Never autonomous, never ambient.

rules.name: The One Cobalt Rule
rules.body: Editorial Cobalt appears on no more than ~10% of any given screen. There is no secondary accent, ever. If a new surface wants a second color, it is wrong. Add hierarchy through type weight, size, or border before reaching for a new hue.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral carries chroma 0.005–0.018 toward hue 256. Pure #fff, pure #000, and untinted grays are forbidden anywhere in the system.

rules.name: The Dark-Default Rule
rules.body: Dark is the explicit default. New surfaces should be designed dark-first.

rules.name: The Mono-Label Rule
rules.body: Every meta marker is JetBrains Mono uppercase at 10–11px with 0.18–0.22em tracking. Body copy and titles are never mono. The font switch is the hierarchy signal.

rules.name: The Negative-Tracking Rule
rules.body: All Inter Tight headings carry letter-spacing -0.015em. This is what makes Inter Tight read editorial rather than utilitarian at large sizes.

rules.name: The Line-Length Cap
rules.body: Body paragraphs are constrained to 62–75ch. Never run a paragraph the full width of a section.

rules.name: The Reactive Lift Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state: hover, scroll, focus. A constant ambient shadow on a static card is forbidden.

rules.name: The Tonal-Depth Rule
rules.body: Three layers, three lightness values: Stage (0.13) → Muted (0.235) → Card (0.195). Card is lighter than Muted on purpose: the Muted section band reads as a recessed track and Card as a raised tile without a single drop shadow.

dos: Do keep Editorial Cobalt at ≤10% of any given screen.
Do use JetBrains Mono uppercase 0.2em-tracked microlabels above every section, list group, and meta row.
Do tint every neutral toward hue 256 with chroma 0.005–0.018.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest and lift them on state.
Do use OKLCH for every color token. Reduce chroma as lightness approaches 0 or 100.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion in every motion island via useReducedMotion().
Do use transform and opacity for animation.
Do ease out with ease-out-quart, ease-out-quint, or ease-out-expo.
donts: Don't add a second accent color.
Don't ship generic developer-portfolio patterns (hero photo over a gradient, same-shape project cards, skills bar chart).
Don't ship SaaS-cream marketing patterns (pastel pills, Trusted by row, hero-metric template).
Don't add ambient decorative motion (full-page WebGL shaders, glitch text, dancing icons, 3D card tilts, bobbing orbs, cursor companions).
Don't use side-stripe borders greater than 1px.
Don't nest a Card inside a Card.
Don't reach for a Modal as the first thought.
Don't animate width, height, top, left, box-shadow, or backdrop-filter values outside the existing liquid-glass surface.
Don't use em dashes in prose copy, content YAML, or page titles. Middot is the approved separator glyph in meta rows.
